lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice receipt, compared to 45 days in the previous contract.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: Both contracts require payment of undisputed invoices within thirty days of receipt.
Same as Rohan Iyer: Both agreements establish a thirty-day payment term from the receipt of an invoice.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ grants a license to its proprietary accelerator PipeKit, whereas it previously received licenses from contractors.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Grants a broad perpetual license to the PipeKit accelerator instead of simply retaining pre-existing tools.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: Both contracts grant the client a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free license to pre-existing tools incorporated into the deliverables.
Same as Acme Retail Group: Both specify a penalty of 0.5% of the milestone fee per week of delay, capped at 5%.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Penalty is 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the milestone, versus 1% of contract value per day.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: The penalty rate is 0.5% per week of delay instead of 1% of milestone fees.
Better for AtliQ than CareBridge Clinics Inc: Aggregate liability is capped at the total contract remuneration instead of two times the annual fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: The liability cap is based on the total contract value rather than the fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: Both limit aggregate liability to the total fees under the agreement or relevant statement of work.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: Mutual indemnity is triggered by any culpable breach, rather than limited to specific categories like IP infringement.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Broad mutual indemnity for any culpable breach, compared to specific triggers like IP infringement and gross negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Mutual indemnity covers any culpable breach rather than being limited to intellectual property infringement claims.
Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: Confidentiality obligations survive for five years after termination, compared to only three years.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Confidentiality is limited to business and trade secrets rather than all information marked or regarded as confidential.
Worse for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Confidentiality obligations survive for five years after termination instead of only two years.
Same as Northwind Logistics: Both require standard data processing terms and contractual clauses for international data transfers to India.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Requires compliance with the more rigorous EU GDPR standards instead of the Indian Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Provides a clear mechanism for data transfers to India via SCCs instead of requiring prior written consent.
Worse for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Disputes are subject to German law and Munich courts instead of English law and London courts.
Worse for AtliQ than Northwind Logistics: Requires litigation in German courts instead of private international arbitration under LCIA rules.
Same as Crestline Retail Inc: Both contracts specify the client's local law and jurisdiction for resolving disputes.
